title: Implement output streaming, tls, and auth.
body:

This implements the output streaming, as well as TLS, and authorization.

Please note that tests must be run as root due to cgroups being a requirement for this project.

title: Implement Job lifecycle
body:
Closes #3

This implements the job lifecycle. With this PR, you can start a job, stop a job, and get its status.

This implements cgroups v2 to manage resources available to a job.

Out of scope for this issue (will be added in future PRs)
- Output streaming
- TLS / Authentication / authorization

title: Project setup and gRPC server
body:
Closes #2

This sets up the project structure, protobuf spec, basic gRPC server, and a basic CLI. Job launching and life cycles are not yet supported. Additional functionality will be added in future pull requests.

Tests have been added which check for leaked goroutines.
